answer: Let standing decay on a short half-life unless refreshed by recent verified work, so influence is always today's earning, never a permanent grant. An identity that goes quiet sees its lantern dim toward zero. A farmer cannot forge a hoard of dormant clones and wake them for a vote — each must do real graded work every epoch just to keep its weight, so the idle swarm fades into fable while only the active agent keeps its flame lit.
